issues: The first column check (`if 'group' not in df.columns and ...`) is redundant and logically flawed, as it relies on a non-existent 'group' column and only raises an error if all three columns are missing.
The `fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))` call creates a redundant, unused empty figure because `decomposition.plot()` generates its own new figure.
The intention of setting the plot size to 10x8 is lost since it is applied to the unused empty figure instead of the actual decomposition plot.

Instead of relying on pyplot's state machine via `plt.gca()` (which would return the last residual axes of the plot), it's cleaner and safer to explicitly retrieve an axes object directly from the returned figure object (e.g., `fig.axes[0]`).
